desc:
Welcome to Sea Monster Siege!
🌊 You’re in the middle of the ocean, part of a desperate crew aboard a ship under siege by legendary sea monsters like El Gran Maja, the Megalodon, the Bloop, or the Kraken.
Will you manage to defeat the sea monsters, or will they drag you down to the bottom of the cold, dark sea? 🥶

Premium Benefits:
✨ Double AutoExp for Morphs

🌟Private Server Benefits:
No Morph cooldown

How to play?
Equip weapons from the menu
Defeat targets or monsters for money
Buy better weapons, vehicles or morphs with money

Controls:
Shift | L3 : Toggle sprint
Left-click | R2 : Shoot
R | X button : Reload

Morph controls:
E | X button : Charge Dash Attack
Shift | L3: Toggle CamLock

👍Like the game for new updates!
